smallest_claim: A transcript-derived Lipschitz constant, including any fixed inflation, is not a certificate; only an independently justified constant makes the sharp interval conditional guarantee valid.

theorem.construction: Keep every observed value and assign the request above the finite upper endpoint; the completion then has a larger finite Lipschitz constant on the augmented finite domain.
theorem.statement: For every finite multiplier of the transcript's empirical Lipschitz lower bound, an unrestricted completion can agree on the transcript and leave the resulting interval at an unobserved request.
